outputs.prompt: Give a concise explanation of opportunity cost with one everyday example.
outputs.reply: Opportunity cost is the value of the next best alternative that is forgone when a choice is made. It represents the potential benefits that could have been obtained by choosing the alternative option. For example, if you decide to spend your weekend at home reading a book instead of going to a movie, the opportunity cost would be the enjoyment and entertainment you would have gained from watching the movie.
